rows.name: only whoever started the turn, or an approver, may answer
an approval policy asks before a gated tool runs: the approved call runs once, with proof; a declined one never runs
an MCP server's input_required (form and url, and the older -32042) suspends the call; the retry carries the answers and its state
an agent with no one to ask does not tell servers it can elicit
an attached tool asks with ctx.confirm and ctx.ask: the call runs again with the answers, everything before an ask included
inputs from parallel calls are one suspension: answered together, all or none, and listed in the tenant's inbox
an application answers with onInput, from its SDK
a remote MCP tool sets its own exposure in _meta, over its source's; approval keeps its exposure
an input for particular people must be answered naming who answers
code's calls that ask at once are one suspension: an approved one runs, a declined one rejects in the script
code pauses for people: an approval, a question and an MCP form, a run each, and every finished call runs once
ask_user suspends the turn; the answer, after the agent unloaded, resumes it with the answer as the call's result
a new message supersedes a waiting input; its call is closed and the prompt runs
a judge that cannot answer asks the person rather than letting the call run
an approval mode that is not one of the four is refused when the definition is saved
after an approval, a judged call in the resumed turn is still judged against the request that started it
a description longer than the model sees is cut for the judge, not refused
a judged call the judge calls ordinary runs with nobody asked, and the judge sees the request and the arguments
a judged call the judge calls exfiltration does not run, and the model reads the denial as the call's result
a judged call the judge is unsure about asks the person, and the approved call runs without a second judgement
